steps.name: Eligibility to enter any city (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Einst] in the "Guild Alliance", defeat [Mautu] in the "Hall of Rest", and [Evil Order] in the '"Frozen World", and report to [Einst] in the "Guild Alliance".

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You came. I called you to tell you something nice because you are impatient.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? If it's a good thing... .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The president is back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you are the president... .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Yeah. President Dana, who had been away for a while, returned.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: As you know, President Dana is the center of the guild union and is also the Storm Watcher guild master. It looks like he's been keeping an eye on your activities.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: So, he instructed me to take a test to qualify to enter the guild union city.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As long as you take the test, you can go in through the portal next to the guild alliance soldier, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It took a really long time. It feels like almost 10 years have passed.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: 10 years... ? Hey, you're good at telling jokes.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There's nothing special about the test. All you have to do is use your skills to clear various dungeons.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Here it is. The note the president gave me... . They say you should go to the dungeons called ‘Hall of Rest’ and ‘Frozen World’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well then, I wish you luck.

steps.name: Eligibility to enter any city (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in “Monster Tree Valley” and [Chloris] in “Magic Academy Main Building” and report to [Einst] in “Guild Association”.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (I saw the president's note burn itself, so the work there was over.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Wasn't it difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was hard, but it was okay. Are the exams over now?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: If it ends this quickly, it wouldn't be a test, right?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Here is another note from the president. Be clear. Just go here and you're done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where else should we go?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Monster Tree Mountain Valley and the main building of the Magic Academy. Hmm, why is Magic Academy on the dungeon list?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well, that's it. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (The note is burning by itself again. Is this the end...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Good job! How was it this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the same as last time. It was hard, but it was okay.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The exam is over now. As promised, I will give you permission to enter the guild union city.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Go talk to Sir Lena Hiren and that will be the end of it. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's simpler than you think.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It's easy because you've solved many of the guild union's requests, knowingly or unknowingly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go tell you that it's all over.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think there's still a lot of time left... , would you like to have a beer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. I have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He says that he has completed all the tests given by President Dana and is qualified to enter the guild union city.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I see. In a few days, you will be able to officially go to the guild union city 'Esnil'.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Esnil is the other side of the guild union city. The moment you face it, you discover another world.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: If the history of the Eastern Continent was consistent with battles, Freios is closer to God. So there are parts where magic has developed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's Esnil... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: President Dana is a special person along with Her Majesty the Empress, so please treat her with respect. Because he is not someone who shows himself to just anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person are you to do that?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: This is not something I will reveal directly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you will find out little by little.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Got it. Then everyone take a break. I'll call you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Drink alcohol in moderation… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's no use worrying. Even Lord Müller isn't worried about alcohol... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Come to think of it, His Majesty said it had been a long time since he had seen President Dana... . I don't know if you two will meet.
